comment: Strict result contract for the nine live host-canary lanes (issue #96).
This file is DATA consumed by the standard-library validator in
executable form of every rule stated here. Artifacts are the committed
canary/<canary_lane>.json files. Verdict semantics: pass/fail/skip all
exit 0 in lane mode -- the verdict lives in the artifact.
rules: lane must be one of lanes; host must equal lane_host[lane]
verdict must be one of the verdict enum values
reason must be a nonempty slug string (a leading '-' is the legacy no-reason marker and is forbidden in lane artifacts)
sha, when non-null, must match the sha256 pattern (lowercase 64 hex)
version, when non-null, must be a nonempty string (the measured stdout line, verbatim)
manifest_hook_ids must be a nonempty list of hook_id-pattern strings derived from the host manifest
fired_hook_ids must be a list of hook_id-pattern strings (empty on complete trust per the codex lane contract)
inventories must contain exactly the four inventory_roots keys; every root maps to an object with sorted before and after lists
entry kind directory carries only kind; kind file carries size and sha256; kind symlink carries a POSIX-relative target
hermes lanes: verdict in (pass, fail) requires callback_evidence to be a nonempty list of nonempty strings; skip exempts it
hermes lanes: mode must be one of the hermes_mode enum values
claude-compact: compact_result is required and must be one of the compact_result enum values (unknown on every indeterminate path, including skip)
zcode-duplicate: one_copy is required and must record the single-copy probe (verdict plus reason single-copy-pass on success)
